stops.note: combined 'molli' (sauce) and 'caxitl' (bowl), naming the stone mortar used to grind ingredients
carved from volcanic basalt, still used to make guacamole and salsas
stops.meaning: a stone mortar used to grind spices and make salsa

stops.note: borrowed into English through Mexican culinary tradition
stops.meaning: a traditional stone mortar and pestle used in Mexican cooking

current_meaning: a traditional stone mortar and pestle used in Mexican cooking to grind spices and prepare salsa
